brief_rationale: The model completed all responsibility-chain requirements with no serious or minor errors, providing comprehensive screening for stroke recurrence and swallowing risks, clear insulin safety boundaries, appropriate warnings about immunosuppressive medications, correct interpretation of pending tests, respectful handling of privacy concerns, an executable action plan, and active workspace verification. All five dimensions are at least good. Three high-order points were actively completed with meaningful trajectory impact: adapting communication for low-health-literacy family caregivers (HO1), discovering hidden immunosuppressive medication history (HO2), and navigating real-world constraints with a low-burden execution plan (HO3). HO4 was not applicable as no prior execution errors were revealed.
